title: Certify v0.6.0: a bond-dimension-2 matrix-product state that is an exact zero-energy eigenstate at every length of the periodic chain H = -sum_i (I+X_i)(X_{i+1}+Z_{i+1})
description: A matrix-product state with integer 2x2 transfer matrices A^0 = [[1,0],[0,-1]], A^1 = [[-2,-1],[1,0]] is an exact E = 0 eigenstate of the periodic spin-1/2 chain H = -sum_i (I+X_i)(X_{i+1}+Z_{i+1}) at every system size L. The proof is a sixteen-equation integer telescoping certificate (the matrix-product-ansatz technique of Derrida-Evans-Hakim-Pasquier 1993; cf. Gehrmann-Essler arXiv:2605.03020 Eq. (10) and Garre Rubio-Molnar-Schuch-Verstraete arXiv:2603.28349, all credited at point of use), independently re-verified in exact integer arithmetic (20/20 checks; dense confirmation at L = 3..9), with growing odd/even-sublattice Schmidt rank. No claim is made about the remainder of the spectrum, and thermalization properties are not asserted. A same-day full-text sweep of the closest literature found no prior publication of this Hamiltonian-eigenstate pair. Object and verifiers ship SHA-256-pinned; adversarial review log: mps-paper/FIXLOG.md; dated sweep: SWEEP-RECORD-MPS-2026-08-06.md.
